programme.title: Jumbo
programme.desc: Jumbo è un elefante che vive su un'isola, è molto intelligente e riesce a sillabare qualsiasi parola. Ogni anno si indice una gara dove partecipano numerosi animali, ciascun partecipante deve sillabare una parola senza sbagliare. Il nostro grande e simpatico eroe viene ostacolato dagli Hollis una famiglia di ranocchi ambiziosi.

programme.title: Le Fantastiche Avventure Di Unico
programme.desc: Unico è un unicorno speciale ha il potere di rendere felici tutti gli esseri viventi, per questo suo dono gli Dei lo vogliono esiliare sulla collina dell'Oblio. Il vento dell'Ovest disubbidisce al volere delle divinità e porta unico sull'isola del Diavolo della Solitudine, iniziano così le fantastiche avventure di Unico, un mix di amicizia e magia e lo condurrà a usare il suo potere a fin di bene, anche se perderà la cosa più importante della sua esistenza.

programme.title: Miseria E Nobiltà
programme.desc: Un giovane figlio di nobili, prevedendo che la sua famiglia non accetterà il suo matrimonio con una ballerina, ingaggia un gruppo di poveracci perché impersonino i suoi parenti davanti ai familiari della fidanzata. I falsi parenti commettono mille gaffes.

programme.title: The Cameraman
programme.desc: Un uomo vorrebbe fare il cameraman per conquistare una bella impiegata della MGM. I suoi filmati sono casuali, ma una scimmia filmerà per caso il suo atto di eroismo e lui conquisterà la bella. Primo lungometraggio di Buster Keaton: un capolavoro. Il cinema come riproducibilità tecnica, come arte d'avanguardia, come industria. L'uomo con la macchina da presa, come Dziga Vertov. I due innamorati, Hollywood e la massa impazzita, come Il giorno della locusta. Un saggio teorico geniale, e un film da...

programme.title: La Quadriglia Dell'amore
programme.desc: Un produttore di riviste e un attore della sua compagnia si recano rispettivamente a Londra e a Parigi per trovare una soubrette per il loro spettacolo. Non solo entrambi hanno successo, ma s'innamorano anche delle loro scoperte.

programme.title: Little Sister
programme.desc: Tre sorelle accolgono la loro sorellastra adolescente dopo la morte del padre, unendosi in una nuova vita.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: Angélique ha 60 anni. Ama ancora le feste, le piacciono ancora gli uomini. Di notte, per guadagnarsi da vivere, gli fa bere in un night club nei pressi del confine con la Germania. Con il passare del tempo, i clienti diventano sempre piu' rari. Ma Michel, suo cliente fisso, è ancora innamorato di lei. Un giorno, chiede a Angélique di sposarlo.

programme.title: Cacciatore Di Teste
programme.desc: Bruno Davert è un manager del settore della carta di mezza età che ha perso il lavoro a causa di una ristrutturazione e delocalizzazione della sua azienda. Convinto di trovare immediatamente un altro lavoro all'altezza del suo curriculum, dopo oltre due anni di ricerche si ritrova ancora disoccupato. Decide così di mettere in atto un piano destinato a restituirgli il lavoro presso la principale azienda del settore, la Arcadia. Il piano consiste nell'eliminazione fisica di tutti i suoi principali...

programme.title: Appuntamento A Ora Insolita
programme.desc: Una cena tra vecchi amici è il pretesto per discutere di sentimenti e vicissitudini e per rivivere emozioni co

programme.title: Tracks: Attraverso Il Deserto
programme.desc: Rick Smolan, giovane e carismatico fotografo del New Yorker e del National Geographic, l'ha seguita in alcune delle tappe del viaggio per raccontare la leggendaria traversata di uno dei più impervi deserti del mondo. Per finanziare il proprio viaggio, Robyn ha accettato a malincuore la presenza occasionale di un fotografo, pur vedendo Rick come un intruso e una minaccia per la riuscita del suo viaggio. Eppure, quello che era nato come un rapporto difficile tra due persone molto diverse si sarebb...

programme.title: Kimba - I Coraggiosi Cambiano Il Futuro
programme.desc: Kimba è un cucciolo di leone bianco, figlio dell'imperatore della giungla, Panja. Kimba è gentile con gli altri animali, però è un pessimo cacciatore, ha persino paura di saltare. A causa di questa sua debolezza, gli altri animali lo deridono. Koko, è l'unica che crede in lui e conosce le sue potenzialità.

programme.title: Anatar
programme.desc: Il popolo degli Anatar, alieni umanoidi che si sono evoluti dalle anatre e sono alla ricerca di un nuovo corpo celeste da chiamare nido. Nel loro peregrinaggio spaziale approdano su Pandoro: un luogo dove essere viventi e natura hanno trovato il loro strano equilibrio. Amore, guerra astronavi e papere spaziali sono gli ingredienti di questa grottesca fiaba moderna sull’ accettazione di cio che è diverso da noi.

programme.title: Misstake
programme.desc: In una villa rurale alle porte di Vicenza si riuniscono un gruppo strampalato di tipi umani. Tutti sono lì per lo stesso motivo: ambiscono al possesso della casa. Quando uno degli ospiti muore improvvisamente, le divergenze tra loro si inaspriscono.

programme.title: L'uomo Dal Futuro
programme.desc: Brasile, 2011. Joao, chiamato da tutti Zero, è un brillante fisico che, nonostante sia a capo di uno dei più grandi progetti scientifici del paese, ha ancora in testa la notte di venti anni prima in cui è stato tradito e umiliato pubblicamente a una festa dalla fidanzata Helena. Quando infine i suoi modi eccentrici e capricciosi rischiano di farlo licenziare, Joao decide di provare prima del tempo la sua invenzione, una macchina che dovrebbe essere una nuova fonte di energia sostenibile per l'um...

programme.title: Pure Relaxation

programme.title: Purple Mountain Wildflowers

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation II 2
programme.desc: Immerse your senses on an unparalleled underwater journey to some of the world's most vibrant coral reefs and undersea paradises as seen in true 4K Ultra High Definition, paired to soothing new music by Relax Moods. Viewers will discover a plethora of stunning sea creatures, thanks to the incredible underwater cinematography by Peter Schneider filmed over the last several years.

programme.title: Waimamaku Beach: New Zealand
programme.desc: This exquisite destination is a roughly 1-hour journey from the nearest community. Experience the remote, cliff-lined, cavernous coastline that's described as the most "spectacular" in the region.

programme.title: Oahu Morning Waves
programme.desc: Relax on the shores of Oahu, Hawaii just after sunrise, where big blue waves crash in golden sunlight. programme.title: Flying Over Greece
programme.desc: Journey through the stunning landscapes of Greece from a bird’s eye view.

programme.title: Lake Mangamahoe: New Zealand

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 172

programme.title: Xplore Jordan
programme.desc: Im Jahr 560 n. Chr. wurde auf dem Boden einer byzantinischen Kirche in Jordanien eine aufwendige Mosaikkarte des Heiligen Landes angefertigt. Heute ist es die weltweit älteste erhaltene originale kartografische Darstellung der biblischen Nationen. Als Shaunak die Kirche besucht, erfährt er, dass die Stadt, in der sie steht, Madaba, einen Schatz antiker Mosaike beherbergt und dass dort noch immer die uralte Kunstform der Mosaikherstellung praktiziert wird.

programme.title: Viajar Peru
programme.desc: Peru – jeder verbindet dieses Land direkt mit dem Machu Picchu und den Inca Ruinen. Die stolze Peruanerin Milagros Maradiegue ist jedoch fest davon überzeugt, dass Peru deutlich mehr zu bieten hat. Von den grünen Regenwäldern des Amazonas bis zu den rätselhaften Nazca-Linien entdeckt sie einige der bestgehüteten Geheimnisse ihres Heimatlandes. Und so entwickelt sich eine Urlaubsreise zu der Wiederentdeckung ihrer eigenen Wurzeln.

programme.title: Xplore Jordan
programme.desc: Stellen Sie sich eine endlose rote Fläche vor, die von verwitterten Felsformationen durchzogen ist – klingt das nach Mars? Das ist Wadi Rum in Jordanien. Es ist eine Stadt, die seit prähistorischer Zeit bewohnt ist und heute Beduinenlager beherbergt. Der Höhepunkt von Shaunaks Reise ist jedoch, als er eine alte Karte findet, die in einer Höhle versteckt ist.

programme.desc: Sukhmani est en vacances au Cambodge, où elle séjourne dans un complexe, qui était autrefois la maison d'hôtes royale.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.sub-title: La Liste De Dan Et Paddy À Khyushu, Japan Ohana
programme.desc: Parmi les secrets les mieux gardés du Japon se trouve sa propre Venise avec une saveur orientale. Daniel Coll et Paddy Doherty visitent ce joyau caché et en apprennent un peu plus sur l'histoire de Kyushu et des samouraïs, les légendaires guerriers japonais. Ils sont également témoins d'un jardin enchanteur, qui est la combinaison parfaite de la créativité de la nature et des êtres humains.

programme.title: 10 Days Cyprus
programme.desc: Située à côté de la magnifique côte méditerranéenne de l'île, dans le sud-ouest de Chypre, la ville populaire de Paphos abrite des attractions archéologiques spectaculaires et une riche histoire chypriote. Ici, Sabrina découvre les mythes des philosophies grecque et romaine, dévoile les histoires cachées dans le temps au parc archéologique de Paphos et explore les villes historiques de Limassol et de Kourion.

programme.title: 10 Days Cyprus
programme.sub-title: 10 Jours À Chypres Parc National D'akamas
programme.desc: D'être le principal mode de transport pendant de nombreux siècles à aider à la production d'huile d'olive, les ânes de Chypre ont vraiment gagné le statut d'animal national. Notre hôte, Sabrina Chakici en apprend plus sur eux et leur importance pour le pays lorsqu'elle visite une ferme d'ânes. Elle visite également le parc national de la péninsule d'Akamas, l'une des dernières régions sauvages du pays insulaire.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.sub-title: Sac À Dos Vallée Du Douro, Portugal
programme.desc: Un site du patrimoine mondial de l'UNESCO depuis 2001, le Douro est une nature sauvage majestueuse, l'une des plus anciennes régions viticoles délimitées au monde. Driek visite les vignobles de la vallée du Douro, où il a la chance d'assister au processus de fabrication du vin et aux modes de vie locaux. Il peut également déguster du vin de Porto millésimé.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.sub-title: La Liste De Dan Et Paddy À Khyushu, Japan Qura
programme.desc: Daniel Coll et Paddy Doherty rendent visite au forgeron primé Matsunaga Genrokuro dans la ville d'Arao à Kyushu, au Japon. Il leur montre quelques trucs sur la fabrication des épées utilisées par les samouraïs et sur la façon de les manier. Ils explorent également quelques sites chrétiens cachés dans la région de Nagasaki.

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.desc: Le groupe de temples de Khajuraho a impressionné des générations avec leur éclat architectural, leurs sculptures complexes et leurs célèbres sculptures érotiques.

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.desc: Qu'il s'agisse d'églises en bois debout, de villages vikings ou d'une ancienne ville minière, les sites du patrimoine de la Norvège sont l'endroit où les visiteurs peuvent découvrir sa riche histoire depuis l'époque où ce n'était qu'une grande étendue de glace et une beauté naturelle envoûtante. Alors que les paysages spectaculaires des fjords de Flåm constituaient le théâtre des guerres vikings.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: Alex Outhwaite découvre l'histoire et l'architecture de Francfort à travers des sites célèbres tels que la cathédrale Kaizerdom et le château d'Eltz.

programme.title: World Spas
programme.sub-title: Spas De Classe Mondiale Kamalaya, Thaïlande
programme.desc: Kamalaya est un paradis holistique pour tous les amateurs de spa fatigués du monde. Au début, cela peut sembler une extravagance luxueuse, mais il a une sérénité dans laquelle vous aimeriez vous imprégner après un emploi du temps chargé.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.sub-title: La Liste De Dan Et Paddy À Khyushu, Japan Sakurajima
programme.desc: Le nom Sakurajima signifie île aux cerisiers en fleurs - et c'est le nom séduisant d'un volcan fumant à Kyushu. Daniel Coll et Paddy Doherty essaient différentes manières de se rapprocher du volcan. Ce sur quoi ils ne comptent pas, c'est une éruption.

programme.title: Unwind
programme.desc: Indeya Passfield visite l'île de Vabbinfaru, un joyau tropical caché à seulement 20 minutes de Malé, la capitale animée des Maldives.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.sub-title: La Liste De Dan Et Paddy À Khyushu, Japan Kagoshima
programme.desc: Daniel Coll et Paddy Doherty visitent Meiji-Gura à Kyushu, au Japon, pour déguster une liqueur forte japonaise brassée localement, le Shochu. Ils se rendent également dans la région de Makurazaki pour un repas spécial de bonite, un délice japonais à base de fruits de mer, préparé pour eux par des chefs de renommée mondiale, Gaggan Anand et Takeshi « Goh » Fukuyama.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: Alex explore Barcelone, une ville connue pour son histoire et ses infrastructures modernes. Elle explore le château de Montjuic, puis visite un marché local et la cathédrale emblématique d'Antoni Gaud

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.desc: Les monuments d'Agra et de Fatehpur Sikri racontent des histoires sur l'opulence moghole et leur amour pour les bonnes choses de la vie.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: Autrefois ville ancienne sur la célèbre route de la soie, Tachkent est un kaléidoscope d'art envoûtant, de nourriture délicieuse, de vastes jardins et d'architecture accrocheuse. Voyageuse de renom, Alex Outhwaite explore la capitale de l'Ouzbékistan, où elle visite des sites emblématiques tels que la médersa Barak-Khan, découvre l'histoire de la ville et goûte des spécialités locales telles que le sheesh kebab, le lait de cheval et la viande de cheval.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.sub-title: La Liste De Dan Et Paddy À Khyushu, Japan Fukuoka
programme.desc: Alors que le reste du Japon restait isolé du monde, la saveur mondiale de Fukuoka a été concoctée par des siècles de commerce avec ses voisins asiatiques. Les aventuriers Daniel Coll et Paddy Doherty assistent à un match de baseball unique dans un stade assez décalé de la plus grande ville de Kyushu.

programme.title: 10 Days Cyprus
programme.desc: Larnaca à Chypre est l'une des 20 villes les plus anciennes du monde, habitées en permanence depuis 4000 ans. Passionnée de voyages, Sabrina entreprend d'en savoir plus sur la ville mais se fait piéger lorsqu'elle trouve une volée de flamants roses au bord d'un lac.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Les sites touristiques de Lisbonne racontent des histoires sur les voyages maritimes de découverte du Portugal.

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.sub-title: Les Grands Hotels Du Monde Amansara 1
programme.desc: Lors de ses voyages à travers le Cambodge, Sukhmani se perd dans les merveilles d'Angkor, le parc archéologique qui la transporte à l'époque de l'empire khmer.

programme.title: 10 Days Cyprus
programme.desc: Dans les chaînes de Troodos de Chypre, Sabrina Chakici visite le monastère de Kykkos et les dix petites églises du village, qui sont devenues un site du patrimoine mondial de l'UNESCO. Elle s'aventure plus loin pour explorer le village néolithique de Khirokitia et en apprendre davantage sur la tradition séculaire de la dentelle dans le village de Lefkara.

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.sub-title: La Liste De Dan Et Paddy À Khyushu, Japan Gyokuro Tea
programme.desc: Le thé au Japon est un concept spirituel. En y attachant rituel et cérémonie, ce pays transforme l'acte de boire du thé en un moment de communion avec l'univers. Daniel Coll et Paddy Doherty découvrent différentes façons de savourer le thé Gyokuro, l'une des plus hautes qualités de thé disponibles au Japon. Ils visitent également le village où il est cultivé.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: D'un ancien monastère et centre d'apprentissage à l'une des plus anciennes universités du monde, bienvenue à Coimbra, la ville universitaire du Portugal.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Lors de la visite de Driek à Porto, la deuxième plus grande ville du Portugal, il se rend directement pour goûter au célèbre vin de Porto qui a fait de la ville un lieu de pèlerinage pour les amateurs de vin. Alors qu'il explore davantage la ville, il tombe sur la librairie de style néo-gothique, où JKRowling s'est sentie inspirée pour écrire son magnum opus, et le splendide Palacio da Bolsa.

programme.desc: Itoshima est un secret bien gardé pour les habitants de Fukuoka, la capitale de Kyushu au Japon. Daniel Coll et Paddy Doherty partent en randonnée vers des cascades apaisantes, essayez de pêcher dans les piscines naturelles et apprenez-en un peu plus sur les croyances des habitants d'Itoshima, un endroit qui apaise vraiment l'âme.

programme.title: 10 Days Cyprus
programme.desc: Nicosie, la capitale de la République de Chypre est aussi son cœur culturel. Sabrina s'en rend compte, alors qu'elle entreprend de démêler les histoires de la plus grande ville de Chypre tout en prenant un bain dans un hammam, qui était autrefois une église.

Passionnée de voyages, Indeya Passfield cherche une expérience plus locale à Hadahaa, où elle fait une excursion dans le monde aquatique avec un biologiste marin. Elle s'essaye également à la confection de préparations de fruits de mer locaux et à la pêche en bateau traditionnel.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E02 - Surfers' Delight
programme.desc: In der ultimativen Testküche des Planeten serviert diese Episode ein besonderes Abendessen für eine Gruppe von Surfern, aber ein Sturm zieht auf. Dies wird ein unvergessliches Erlebnis. Auf der Speisekarte stehen gemischter Blattsalat mit Himbeervinaigrette, Weißfischgelatine mit Gurken- und Maisrelish gefolgt von gebratenem Heilbutt und Polenta.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E03 - Hunters Paradise
programme.desc: Catering abseits der Stromnetze ist nicht einfach, und die Familie Ewing weiß das. Eine Gruppe von 8 Jägern wird mit einem Rote-Bete-Salat gefolgt von geschmortem Wildbret und zum Dessert Käsekuchen mit Preiselbeeren bewirtet.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E04 - Celebration
programme.desc: Ein weiteres 5-Sterne-Essen der Familie Ewing. Diesmal ist es ein Abendessen für einige Einheimische. Bradley entscheidet sich, auf die Jagd nach einer Ziege für den ersten Gang zu gehen: ein langsam geschmortes Ziegeneintopf, gefolgt von einem Fischrisotto, und als Hauptgericht - Curryziege mit Apfel- und Hagebuttenchutney. Zum Abschluss des Dinners gibt es einen Schokoladen-Schmelzkuchen zum Dessert.

programme.title: Life on the Edge - S01:E01 - The Aleutian Islands - The Last Frontier
programme.desc: "Leben am Limit" erkundet die harten Aleuteninseln, den Wilden Westen der letzten Grenze, wo amerikanische Pioniere und Abenteurer in einem der abgelegensten und herausforderndsten Orte der Welt ein Zuhause finden. Angesichts harter Bedingungen treiben diese Pioniere abseits der Zivilisation sich selbst an, während sie neue Unternehmen gründen, Infrastruktur aufbauen und ein Leben am Rand der Zivilisation schaffen. Wildnisführer Charlie Summerville gibt alles für den Bau einer Hütte im Aleuten-Bärengebiet, während Cowboy Pat Harvie die abgelegenste Ranch Amerikas auf der wilden Umnak-Insel leitet.

programme.title: Life on the Edge - S01:E02 - Volcano Bay
programme.desc: Charlie Summerville, unser Guide, bereitet alles in Volcano Bay vor, um ein Camp einzurichten. Er plant den Bau einer Hütte für Abenteurer, die Nervenkitzel suchen.

programme.title: Life on the Edge - S01:E03 - Engine Trouble
programme.desc: Schlechtes Wetter in den Aleuten hat Charlie Summerville und sein Bau-Team in Volcano Bay gestrandet, während Pat Harvies alte Autos Motorprobleme haben.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E01 - Meet Island Air
programme.desc: Tausende von Abenteurern strömen auf die Insel Kodiak, um die Wildnis Alaskas beim Jagen, Fischen und bei der Beobachtung von Wildtieren zu erleben, und Island Air Service macht diese einmaligen Unternehmungen zur Realität. Sie fliegen bei Nebel, Regen, Schnee oder Graupel und bringen Naturliebhaber, Einheimische, Vorräte und Materialien in die entlegensten Winkel der Insel. Für einen Kodiak-Buschpiloten und die Mitarbeiter von Island Air ist das alles nur eine Frage der Zeit.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E02 - Fight or Flight
programme.desc: Während eines Routine-Rundflugs kämpfen die Piloten bei einem heftigen Sturm um die Sicherheit ihrer Passagiere.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E03 - Deadman's Survival
programme.desc: Island Air kämpft gegen die Zeit und die Elemente, um eine Gruppe zu retten, die in Deadman's Bay gefangen ist.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E04 - Desperate Times
programme.desc: Island Air setzt eine Gruppe verzweifelter Jäger im Herzen des Busches ab, während Kodiak von einem tiefen Frost heimgesucht wird.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E05 - Risky Business
programme.desc: Der Pilot Peter Rosendahl kämpft mit dem Wind und der kabbeligen See, während er eine Gruppe von Jägern zu einer schwimmenden Hütte bringt.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E06 - Training Day
programme.desc: Island Air ist die Lebensader für viele Menschen in Kodiak. Manchmal verhindert das heftige Wetter die Landung der Flugzeuge, so dass Erik den Tag nutzt, um Pete zu zeigen, wie man die Kameraluke für eine kleine Zielübung benutzt.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots - S01:E07 - Surf's Up
programme.desc: Bei rauer See wenden sich einige Surfer an Island Air, um das Abenteuer ihres Lebens zu erleben.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E01 - A Family Affair
programme.desc: In den abgelegenen Ecken des Alaska-Buschlands gibt es Schätze wie keine anderen. Rau, wild und jetzt gekocht - dies ist die letzte kulinarische Grenze, wo ein Koch neu definiert, was es bedeutet, wie ein Wildmann zu essen. Anspruchsvolle Kunden, bipolare Wetterwechsel und Nahrungs- sowie Versorgungsknappheiten bringen Bradley oft an den Rand seiner Vernunft, aber dieser kreative Freigeist schafft es immer, abzuliefern.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Crow notices that Zarc is starting to lose his composure, leading him and Sawatari to up their game against Zarc's dragons. As dimensional integration is getting closer to completion, Reiji tries to convince his dad to stop Zarc.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Ray's soul possesses Reira so she can battle against Zarc alongside Reiji. Zarc boasts that he is the creator of Pendulum Summon, but Ray is determined to stop him once and for all using the four natural energy cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Things have seemingly returned to normal in the Pendulum Dimension, but Yuya gets the feeling that something is missing. Reiji has him duel against Tsukikage to restore his memories and make him finish the Lancer's goal for good.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The battle royale continues. As Yuya keeps fighting, his memories start flooding back to him. Yuzu's dad suddenly remembers too as the rest of the world slowly begins to remember the Lancers and the battle against Zarc.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Reiji reveals that Zarc is still alive and Reira is barely holding back his malevolence. The world must be united and Yuya must purge Zarc's evil once and for all. Yuya is unsure. but Gongenzaka attempts to ignite his fighting spirit.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya arrives in the Xyz Dimensions with Dennis as his next opponent. Threatening to turn the traumatized citizens of Heartland into cards again, Dennis forces Yuya into a duel against him and his Xyz/Fusion mix.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya arrives in the Fusion Dimension where he finds a distraught Shun. Like with Yuya's counterparts, Ruri and the others have not been resurrected following Ray's revival. Yuya tries to calm Shun down only to end up the target of his fury.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Jack appears to taunt Yuya over his fear of using his counterpart's dragons in fear of summoning Zarc. Unable to accomplish anything as is, Yuya challenges Jack to a duel while Reiji makes it so everyone can watch the battle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya finally listens to his other selves and summons all four of his dragons to defeat Jack. However, there is one final challenge before him in order to become a Dueltainer and purge Zarc: his rival and friend Reiji Akaba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The curtain is about to fall for the last time. The final battle between Yuya and Reiji rages on. Dragons face off against D/D/D as the whole world watches. What will be the final fate of Yuya, Yuzu, and all four dueling dimensions?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In Heartland, Yuma Tsukumo aspires to be the world's best Duelist. Despite this, he is not a good Duelist. When he ends up Dueling, Shark, a student known to have pro-level skills, odd things begin to happen and Yuma's story begins.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The Duel between Yuma and Ryoga comes to its conclusion. In order to take down "Leviathan Dragon", Yuma obtains a "Number" monster of his own, "Utopia".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Astral's been unable to leave since Yuma Dueled Shark, so, despite his reluctance, he's begun living with Yuma. At an inconvenient time, Akari Tsukumo has trouble when her PC she uses as a stay-at-home reporter crashes. When her big scoop is deleted as a result of a system down the city suffered, she orders Yuma to find an alternate scoop she can use for another manuscript. When Yuma goes into town, the traffic lights go nuts, causing downtown to fall into chaos. Yuma looks for the criminal who spread the computer virus that caused all this chaos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma challenges Professor Kitano, who is behind it all. Professor Kitano notes that each time he reduces his opponent's Life Points with "Electronic Computer-Beast Tera Byte" Astral's body weakens, causing him to slowly vanish! To make things worse, the Explosive Virus Time Bomb Ukyo has set is slowly reaching its countdown.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: A strange shadow approaches Yuma, which turns out to be Tokunosuke Omoteura, a classmate of Yuma's known for his duplicitous tongue. In the morning, Yuma was reprimanded for a prank he pulled in front of the whole class that he has no memory of causing. As a result, he's been cut off from every one else. Tokunosuke gently says "Let's Duel". With "Baby Tragon" his new Xyz Monster, Yuma might enjoy this duel, but Tokunosuke seems to be planning something.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Tokunosuke steals Yuma's "Utopia", causing Astral to vanish. Tokunosuke wanted the great power of Numbers, and Yuma tries to Summon "Leviathan Dragon" to fight back, but Tokunosuke's Trap Card takes even that away. When Yuma is pushed into a corner with his field, an unexpected monster will become the Trump Card of the Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After having been around a while and having to work with Yuma, Astral's been fascinated by a TV Show Hero named "Different Dimension ESPer Robin". For some reason, Astral feels close and similar to this Robin from an alternate universe. One day, pictures show up with Robin in a fight downtown! Yuma, prodded by Astral, goes with Kotori to where the autographs were taken and meets Robin's actor, a kid named Fuya! But Fuya is a timid boy who doesn't resemble the Robin they all admire in the slightest.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The mysterious person posing as Robin around town was Fuya. Under the intolerable strain of being a hero, Fuya's heart has been overcome by darkness Yuma challenges him to a Duel to save his soul. Robin, however, possesses "Number 83: Galaxy Queen". With it, he proceeds to summon one character after another from the TV Show. At first, Yuma and Astral were amused by this, but due to Galaxy Queen's almighty Monster Effect, they quickly grow impatient. To make things worse, Galaxy Queen, who currently possesses Robin, has taken on the appearance of Fuya's mother.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: A suspicious shadow is trailing Yuma. It seems someone has been after Yuma, and their identity is the unassuming girl Cat-chan from Yuma's class. Yuma and Kotori fall into Cat-chan's trap. To rescue Kotori, he's going to have to Duel. Astral is cautious of the strange vibes he's getting from Cat-chan, especially with the strategy of her "Transforming Cat Deck"!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma is reminded that his victories in his current Duels are due to Astral's help. To prove his skills, he fights Shark once more. Though Shark doesn't care to Duel again, he finally agrees when he finally reaches the end of his rope due to Yuma's constant following him around. The Duel of these two begins. Can Yuma win against Shark, who has no "Number" cards, when he himself declares he won't use his "Number" cards or take the aid of Astral!?After his Duel with Shark, Yuma Duels Tetsuo Takeda without "Numbers" and loses twenty times in a row, with Tetsuo angry because Yuma lied about not using the "Numbers" against Shark. Yuma is scolded by Astral on his immaturity. On the other hand, Shark returns to "his place" where he gets involved in criminal company. Yuma, who knew what was going on with Shark, challenges the two strongest thugs: Rikuo and Kaio, to what Shark proposes to be a 2 on 2 "Tag-Team Duel".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After his Duel with Shark, Yuma Duels Tetsuo Takeda without "Numbers" and loses twenty times in a row, with Tetsuo angry because Yuma lied about not using the "Numbers" against Shark. Yuma is scolded by Astral on his immaturity. On the other hand, Shark returns to "his place" where he gets involved with a criminal network. Yuma, who knew what was going on with Shark, challenges the two strongest thugs: Rikuo and Kaio, to what Shark proposes to be a 2 on 2 "Tag-Team Duel".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma finds himself pinned down by the overwhelming power of "Number 61: Volcasaurus". To protect their precious remaining Life Points, he defends Shark at his own expense. When their opponents summon their second Number monster at that point, Astral becomes aware of the hidden mysteries underlying the Duel. In a last-ditch effort, Shark notices Yuma's passion and entrusts him with 1 card that could turn the whole Duel around!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After a series of incidents, Yuma and Astral learn of the existence of a "Number Hunter". Astral remains wary of an unseen presence, but Yuma pretends not to care. As a result, a series of strange phenomena appear around these two. Undeniably, these are the signs of the coming of the "Number Hunter" named Kaito Tenjo. At that moment, a dangerous Duel with the Numbers cards on the line begins. With Kaito's power far beyond their reckoning, what can Astral or Yuma possibly do?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In just 1 Turn, Kaito Summons 2 Numbers. Yuma attempts to resist the onslaught, but all of his monsters have been removed from the field...! Kaito, capable of even more, summons the strongest Monster to exist: "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon", which has never been seen before! Yuma summons "Number 39: Utopia" to create a turnaround despite the impossible odds facing him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Having clearly seen Kaito's power, and how utterly hopeless they are, Yuma and Astral are keenly aware that they cannot easily recover. At that time, Yuma talks to his grandmother. She mentions a mysterious old man named Jurou at a "Duel Lodge" who owns a wooden statue of the Legendary Monster "Dark Magician", who is waiting for Yuma and his crew. Yuma makes a strong wish based on his desire to train and get better!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: It's a Duel against Jurou's former disciple, Yamikawa! Yamikawa draws his Ninja monsters, pinning Yuma down, but believing in the power of his friends, Yuma must continue this battle to the Death! But, Yamikawa summons his Trump Card, the Number Monster "Armed Ninja - Crimson Shadow"! However, Yuma continues to believe in the power of his friends, but can this possibly lead him to win the Duel!?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Kotori and her friends, who are interested in the Number cards, plus Astral, form the "Number Club". To get more info about the Numbers, they visit the home of a fortuneteller, but the fortuneteller is under the orders of Kaito to collect the Number Cards! When the fortuneteller, Jin, kidnaps Kotori and the rest, Yuma and Astral come to the rescue, but the memory of their Duel with Kaito comes back, the visions of which continue to haunt them!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: To save Kotori and the rest, Yuma continues to fight with Jin over the Numbers. Yuma's Life Points continue to fall, putting the fate of Kotori and the rest in a perilous situation, as Jin worsens things by summoning a second Numbers. In the midst of such a terrible pinch, Astral finds himself scared by Kaito's looming shadow, but when he sees Yuma who refuses to give up, he steps back up to the fight. With the feelings of these two guys, "Utopia" obtains a new power!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma misplaces the the Emperor's Key that was an important momento from his parents. He and Astral look high and low for it, but they just can't seem to find it. While they look, Astral is curious as to how the Emperor's Key is related to Yuma's father. Yuma starts talking about various memories from his childhood that he remembers about his dad. Yuma's Never-Give-Up Spirit "Kattobingu" was born from a promise he made with his father.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma safely recovers "Number 96: Black Mist" from a man. Tetsuo, who witnessed the Duel, takes note that Yuma seems suddenly more brutal in his strategy, and ends up in a fight with him. Not having reconciled in over 2 days, suddenly Number 96 swallows Yuma and Astral up!! To rescue Yuma and Astral from Number 96, Tetsuo fights the Numbers for the first time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: As they head home from class, Yuma and his friends meet Lilly who becomes their friend. However, after the robot is reprogrammed to its former self, Yuma duels Lilly in order to help regain her memories.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In order to protect Yuma's Key from Kite, Shark faces him in a Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: While Yuma seeks for his Key, Astral duels against Kite to defend the Number cards he possesses.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Despite being unable to fight against the immense power of Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon, Astral, his resolve stern due to Feeling the Flow, continues a desperate combo of Offense and Defense. But when he finally gives up against Kite who keeps attacking him over and over, Yuma appears and the mysterious ZEXAL power activates...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: One morning, Yuma heads to school, and while talking to his friends, time stops. He sees three suns shining in the sky. Together with Astral, they both shiver from a fear they do not understand, causing Yuma to run off to find out what possibly could have happened. At that time, Kite, using Dr. Faker's technology, retraces Astral's memories and invites Yuma to the World Duel Carnival.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The World Duel Carnival, where Duelists from around the world will wage heated battles, is swiftly approaching. Yuma, seeking to fulfill his dream of becoming "Duel Champion", excitedly rushes to the tournament. But what will Yuma do when he has no Heart Pieces, which serve as the proof of participation for the WDC? Meanwhile, Mr. Heartland and Kite make their preparations to gather the Numbers that are likely to assemble before them in this tournament.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma's first opponent in the World Duel Carnival is the soccer kid, Striker. Striker transforms the surrounding stadium with his Field Spell Card, as the Duel kicks off. With his "Offside Trap", Striker brilliantly seals Yuma's strategies, while his teammate monsters use teamwork to frantically keep beating Yuma up with a combo of offense and defense and with such sheer strength, it seems as if Striker's victory is decided...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: While looking for an opponent to Duel, Yuma meets a boy named Cody, who loves construction equipment, at a construction site. Yuma, interested in the construction equipment Deck Cody uses, challenges him to a Duel. However, Cody Xyz Summons his "Digvorzhak, King of Heavy Industry".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Anna Kaboom attempts to kill Yuma with a cannon. He negotiates with her and they Duel instead so that Anna can try to take her revenge. Their past history is not what it initially seems.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Tombo Tillbitty Duels people, defeating them with his "Basket Rule" and takes their Heart Pieces. Dextra and Nistro appear near one of the defeated Duelists. They see he has vegetables stuffed in his mouth, and Dextra sees blood on his shirt. Dextra inspects closer, and licks it up, telling the disgusted Nistro it's just tomato juice.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Charlie McCay steals "Number 7: Lucky Straight" from a gallery. Kari, who has past history with Charlie, sends Yuma after him. He and Astral witness the power of the "Lucky Straight" when Charlie performs a One Turn Kill on a World Duel Carnival competitor. Charlie makes his escape, stealing more cards in the process, including one of Yuma's "Numbers".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Charlie McCay escapes on the single-track railroad and Yuma starts the Duel. But Charlie's "Number 7: Lucky Straight" possesses amazing luck. If he hits the jackpot by rolling the dice, then Charlie's Life Points will become 100,000. On the verge of giving up when all of his attempts to stop that strong luck become fruitless, Yuma discovers an unexpected strategy.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The second day of WDC starts. More energetic than ever, Bronk and Caswell decide to battle the Asian Duel Champion, Quattro. According to these two, the gentleman Quattro has a respectable Duel aesthetic, which is also admired by many Duelists from their hearts. Witnessed by Yuma, Astral, Tori and Trey, the Battle Royal between Quattro, Bronk, and Caswell starts, but Quattro soon reveals his true side which remained hidden until now.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Shark is determined to have his revenge on Quattro, but Quattro's younger brother Trey snares Shark with a Duel Anchor and allows Quattro to leave. Trey's mission from Vetrix and Quinton is to give a "Number" to Shark, which he accomplishes. Shark is able to resist completely being controlled by the "Number" and defeats Trey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After Yuma laments over Shark dueling in revenge against Quattro, he's irritated by everything that's going on and ends up getting into a squabble with Tori. Meanwhile, elsewhere in the tournament, a photographer named Cameron has won Duel after Duel against Duelists with the help of terrifying ability of his that leaves them in terror. Cameron's superpower is apparently a gift to be able to take photographs of the future. With Cameron's "Future Photographs", his opponent's entire strategy is laid bare before him, allowing him to relentlessly defeat Duelists.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma is having trouble in his Duel against Cameron, and the dangerous future of Tori encountering an accident is continuously approaching. Then, "Number 25: Force Focus", controlled by Cameron, finally shows up. Yuma cannot win without Summoning "Utopia", but according to the prophecy, Yuma will lose in this Duel for sure if he Summons it. Under this desperate circumstance, in order to grasp the future within his own hands, Yuma delivers a bold strategy!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In order to prevent Flip from being disqualified from the WDC, Yuma Duels against Dextra and Nistro. Meanwhile, Astral faces against an old enemy inside Emperor's Key.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The Duel between Yuma against Dextra and Nistro continues. Due to their combination, Yuma is pushed into a corner, even after Summoning "Utopia" thanks to Astral. However due to the bonds between the two, a reversal occurs!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma's Heart Pieces are stolen by Pip, and Cathy Duels to get them back.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: To heal his little brother Hart's illness, Kite rigorously continues hunting the "Number" cards. Seeing his older brother exhausted, Hart sneaks away from Heartland and into Heartland City, and by chance meets Yuma, Astral and Tori. Amazingly, Hart can see Astral, who in turn seems to know Hart's name. Moved by Astral's wish, Yuma takes Hart to his home. After Hart escaped from the Heartland Tower, he is chased by Dextra and Nistro in a helicopter which results in them going to a tower in order to meet Kite. Soon after, a helicopter appears, in which Hart, Yuma and Tori think it is Nistro and Dextra, resulting in Hart using his Dark Energy. After Yuma calms Hart down with a piece of caramel, the helicopter lands, but instead of Dextra and Nistro, the person piloting it was in fact Quinton. He uses his crest to take control of Hart in order to take him to Vetrix. He then flies off, leaving Yuma and Tori confused as to who he was and what he wanted with Hart.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Hart is kidnapped by the Vetrix Family and so Kite and Yuma join forces. However when they find their hideout, they're forced into a Tag Duel against Quattro and Trey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The Tag Duel of Yuma and Kite against Quattro and Trey begins! Kite duels essentially on his own, even to the extent of hurting all of his opponents, including Yuma. However, Yuma on his part, defends himself and Kite from Trey and Quattro's damaging combination. Furthermore, even with "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" being Summoned, it falls victim to Quattro and Trey's trap.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The Tag Duel of Yuma and Kite against Quattro and Trey begins! Kite duels essentially on his own, even to the extent of hurting all of his opponents, including Yuma. However, Yuma on his part, defends himself and Kite from Trey and Quattro's damaging combination. Furthermore, even with "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" being Summoned, it falls victim to Quattro and Trey's trap.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Due to the terror of Trey and Quattro's strategy, Kite and Yuma are pushed into a corner. However at the edge of defeat, Hart's feelings awaken a new power inside Kite. With it, he Summons the monster created by the powerful bonds between them, "Neo Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma finds himself in conflict about the "Number" cards, knowing that both Kite and Astral have their reasons for obtaining them. However upon learning that his father is still alive, Yuma tries to leave in search for him. Roku appears to help Yuma with his situation.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The third day of the preliminaries begins with Yuma looking for one more Heart Piece. Meanwhile, Nistro who wants to defeat Yuma and Astral, enters the tournament along with Dextra. Consequently while collecting Heart Pieces, Nistro challenges Nelson Andrews.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.desc: Prepárate para una lucha de plumas cuando Téa se enfrente al Pingüino de Pesadilla de Big 2 Crump, donde el perdedor quedará atrapado para siempre en un bloque de hielo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.desc: ¡El Arca de Shinato de Noé roba monstruos en su fortaleza para usarlos como un muro impenetrable de sirvientes!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba está a punto de acabar con Noah, ¡pero Mokuba protege a Noah de su golpe final!

programme.sub-title: La amenaza final de Noah: Parte 2

programme.desc: El Helpoemer de Marik no solo envía las cartas poderosas de Joey al cementerio antes de que él pueda utilizarlas, sino que además, Joey sufre dolor por cada monstruo que va al cementerio.

programme.desc: Atrapado y a punto de morir, Joey cree que este duelo no puede empeorar. ¡Pero Marik tiene todas las piezas para invocar al Dragón Alado de Ra! ¿Podrá Joey evitar que Marik invoque la carta del dios egipcio o simplemente la victoria no está en las cartas?

programme.desc: Marik transforma al Dragón Alado de Ra en su poderosa forma, ¡el dios egipcio Fénix! Si Joey no puede resistir las llamas infernales del fuego abrasador del Fénix, se quemará y perderá el duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.desc: El enfrentamiento de los dos dioses egipcios libera energías místicas que muestran a Yugi y Kaiba visiones del antiguo pasado egipcio. ¿Qué nuevas respuestas desvelan estas imágenes y qué profecías hacen para el futuro?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.desc: Kaiba no solo controla al Dragón Definitivo de Ojos Azules, el monstruo que utilizó para derrotar a Yugi en el Reino de los Duelistas, sino que su carta de Órdenes de Ataque Final deja a Yugi con solo tres cartas en su mazo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La batalla por el bronce: Parte 1

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La batalla por el bronce: Parte 2
programme.desc: Kaiba ataca con su poderoso Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules, pero Joey no tiene monstruos con los que defenderse. La suerte de Joey se ha agotado. ¡Es hora de que confíe en su habilidad!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es Obelisco el Atormentador contra... ¿Obelisco el Atormentador? Yugi no puede golpear los puntos de vida de Marik porque el indestructible dios egipcio Baba de Marik resucita en cada turno.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Ni siquiera con la fuerza de ataque infinita de Obelisco el Atormentador, puede Yugi derrotar al Dragón Alado de Ra.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey busca un oponente de duelo al que pueda vencer y acaba aceptando valientemente un reto de la veterana duelista Mai.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Si Yugi es eliminado del torneo, la malvada Junta Directiva de KaibaCorp entregará el control de la compañía a Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi debe batirse en duelo con un doble mágico de Kaiba creado a partir de la codicia y la sed de poder que Yugi le borró del alma. Yugi tendrá que descubrir una estrategia para sobrevivir al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules de Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi derrota al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules, ¡pero hay dos más esperando en las alas! ¿Llegará el verdadero Kaiba hasta Yugi a tiempo para ayudar a vencer a este imitador?
